name: Satsuki-iro no Sora ni
source:
It's been a month since Shuuya and others moved into this city.
Shuuya and Asami started living together. His daily life was monotone but peaceful until he met Kikyou and Anon.

A little bittersweet story of love and change.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE143397.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
修也等人搬进这座城市已经一个月了。
秀也和麻美开始同居。他的日常生活单调而平静，直到他遇到了Kikyou和Anon。

一个关于爱与改变的苦乐参半的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE143397.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
